text:
maria_cs: FYI — at 11:05 PT we started seeing 502s from webhook ingestion impacting tenant provisioning. ~120 trial onboardings queued. Incident INC-4729. @sam_sre can you confirm scope and ETA?

ops_bot: Incident INC-4729 created · Severity: high · Bridge: https://redwood/bridge/INC-4729 · Pager notified

sam_sre: checking logs now. 11:12 — multiple ingest-worker 502s, looks like a dedupe goroutine hit memory pressure causing OOM restarts. Starting a rolling restart of ingest workers, will rollback last deploy if restart doesn't clear it. ETA 20–30m.

david_csm: I'll draft customer communications. Plan: apology + short cause + mitigation + ETA + credit + offer office hours. Keep legal-safe language. Any phrasing to avoid?

jordan_pm: add explicit "no customer data was exposed" line. Suggest including retry workaround: advise customers to resend webhook deliveries after ~20m. Link status page.

maria_cs: prioritize outreach to high-touch and accounts near renewal. I have a list of 18 high-touch onboarders.

david_csm: uploaded list: https://drive.redwood/incs/INC-4729/affected_high_touch.csv — will send targeted notes first, then a broader status post.

sam_sre: 11:28 — rolling restart done. Consumer lag falling, error rate trending to zero. Monitoring for 15m to confirm queue drain.

ops_bot: INC-4729 update: mitigation applied (rolling restart); monitoring window started.

maria_cs: CS comms plan:
- targeted email to 18 HT accounts within 30m
- public status.post on status.redwood.ai after confirmation
- account credit (small) for delay + 1:1 enablement office hours this week
- customer-facing RCA EOD, exec summary tomorrow

jordan_pm: legal looped in. Use wording: "applied as account credit" not "refund".

david_csm: Draft targeted email (sending now):

---
Hi <CustomerName>,

Sorry for the interruption — a processing issue briefly delayed tenant provisioning this morning. Our engineers applied a fix and your onboarding queue should be processing again. No action needed; if you see webhook failures please retry deliveries after ~20 minutes.

We will apply a small credit to your account for the delay and invite you to a 1:1 troubleshooting session if you'd like help completing setup. Reply here or open a support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai

Sincerely,
Redwood Customer Success
---

sam_sre: 11:40 — metrics look good, error rate at 0. Confirmed queue drained by 11:42.

ops_bot: INC-4729 status -> mitigated. Monitoring continuing.

maria_cs: thanks — David, please send targeted emails and log replies in the CS tracker. Escalate any renewal risk replies to me directly.

david_csm: targeted emails sent 11:41. Two customers requested live help; booked office hours at 15:00 PT. Will consolidate replies into tracker.

sam_sre: RCA notes for EOD: root cause was a regression from a dedupe optimization in the recent deploy which lacked backpressure for large payloads, causing memory pressure and OOM restarts. Immediate fix: rolling restart + revert of faulty change; longer-term fixes: add backpressure, circuit-breaker, and an ingest integration test.

maria_cs: can we get a compact RCA draft by 17:00 for CS to publish by EOD?

sam_sre: yes, will deliver. Thanks all :pray:
